name: Safety Cover
summary: A big red delete button under a hinged safety cover, with an LED ring and a live wipe counter
about: Safety Cover guards a destructive action the way control panels do. A brushed metal plate holds a big red button under a striped, smoky safety cover; lift the cover and it swings up on its hinge, the LED ring blinks amber and an eight-second arm timer starts. Press the button and it sinks in while the ring fills red and the counter wipes 2,846 log entries down to zero, then everything flashes green, the cover drops shut with a thud and new logs trickle back in.
how: Press the striped cover (or Tab to it and press Enter); it catches, then swings up on its hinge.
The LED ring blinks amber and the display counts down 8 seconds before the cover closes by itself.
Press the red button: it sinks in, the ring fills red and the counter runs down to zero while the plate hums.
All LEDs flash green with a shock ring and sparks, and the cover drops shut with a thud.
Esc or pressing the cover again closes it without deleting anything.
